principals.name: A
principals.description: the initiator or responder in a run: generates protocol nonces when serving the initiator role, encrypts requests and decrypts the server-issued credential using the long-term symmetric key K_as.

principals.name: B
principals.description: the responder or initiator in a run: generates protocol nonces when serving the responder role, encrypts its request component and decrypts the server-issued credential using the long-term symmetric key K_bs; it forwards A's credential to A.

principals.name: S
principals.description: the trusted authentication server: decrypts the two long-term-key-protected request components, checks their identifiers and session marker, generates the session key K_ab, and encrypts the two returned credentials.

values.name: K_as
values.description: K_as is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.

values.name: K_bs
values.description: K_bs is a pre-run symmetric key or keying value.
